The first review missed it (caught only priority inheritance), the unconditional first revision fixed only that, and the terminal re-review listed the overlap as a minor too late to be fixed. External scorer: 'Epic Boundaries — solid with one minor overlap' → decomposition_quality 4/5. Root cause: decomposer lacks a spec-vs-content boundary rule; detection is stochastic and terminal.",

    },

Step 7 has no rollout-gate coverage rule; review Criterion 6 doesn't name the pattern. Same review-passes-with-unfixed-minors mechanism as cluster A; possible secondary deduction in the scorer's truncated AC-Quality rationale.",
